text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day off... Smart Falcon called me out 
to a sweet shop in a department store 
basement.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh♪ Sweets are the absolute classic 
when it comes to cute imagery, after all!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Diligent research is essential if I want 
to become a top umadol, after all!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And so, without further ado, let's do an 
on-the-scene report... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That girl walking over from the other 
side... Could she be—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Hello. Situation: "Coincidence."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It really is Bourbon-chan! If you're here, 
does that mean you're after some sweets?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Sweet treats allow for efficient 
energy intake, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Today, in order to carefully select finer 
goods, I have come here where specialty 
shops gather.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Which means it's research time! That's why 
Falco came here too~☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're here, I wanna eat sweets 
together! What do you say, Bourbon-chan♪"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Order approved. Collaborating toward the 
same objective is projected to yield even 
greater results.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Then, as our initial operation— I propose 
consuming all 42 items sold at the front 
stall.
choice_data_list:
I-if you eat that much, your weight 
will...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
B-But! To see the research through, we 
have to throw ourselves right into the 
fray!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So... please, Trainer! Let Falco and the 
others go!
choice_data_list: Sorry, there's no way I can allow that...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Gaaaaaah!!! N-No waaay~...!!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...It is unfortunate, but considering the 
potential impact of rapid weight gain, it 
is a sound decision.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
As an alternative, how about 'Window 
Research,' focusing primarily on visual 
information gathering?
choice_data_list:
In that case, there shouldn't be any 
problem.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I see... The real selling point of sweets 
is nailing both the taste and the 
presentation, after all!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
To switch to another plan right away, 
Bourbon-chan is super motivated!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All right! Falco's gonna research every 
single bit of cuteness there is☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm not going home until Falco's 
UmaStagram is overflowing with sweets 
visual reviews!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward... with serious expressions, 
they headed to the sweets shop.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Thank you~! We did it, 
Bourbon-chanâ

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...All digestive organs have completed 
transition from standby mode to active 
mode.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Let us commence collaborative research 
immediately. Our ultimate goal is to 
conquer every single shop on the floor...!
choice_data_list: I-I can feel such tremendous drive...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Your determination to reach your 
goal is practically buzzing through the 
air...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
B-But still! Falco won't lose to anyone 
when it comes to passion for cuteness☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna indulge in sweets until Falco's 
Umastagram is filled to the brim with 
tasting reviews!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward... they researched by 
taste-testing a countless variety of 
sweets.
